name: Blueprint Builder
description: Reads .csv blueprints from a 'blueprints' folder and builds them in-world with /build1 (downward wall) or /build2 (sideways floor). Supports a translucent 'scaffold' build guide and a 'bot' mode that puppets the player. Also adds a per-block-coloured Canvas Block and /buildCanvas for importing RGB-CSV pixel art, plus the Canvas Cache long-distance renderer (/canvasCache) with on-disk LOD pyramids so huge images stay visible far beyond chunk range.
